hero_mockup.advice: Hero mockups are IMAGES of a site's first screen (GPT Image), not code. Run the skill through the Owner's Codex CLI: `python -X utf8 -I <skill>/scripts/heroes_codex.py <check|render|fix|review|board> --project <folder>` (no OPENAI_API_KEY; -X utf8 is required on Windows). Up to 20 renders per batch without asking; above that, tell the Owner the count first. The API path (heroes.py + OPENAI_API_KEY, about $0.05 per image) is the fallback: up to $5 per batch without asking. Keep `<folder>/out/` and reference screenshots out of git.
